facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy's presentation lists a 'Government Cloud Policy, Strategy and implementation plan 2023' among the Gambia's policies, strategies and legal frameworks, and says the Government Cloud Strategy 2023-2027 builds on the cloud policy; the document gives no more specific date, so 2023 is the year the document names.

The presentation describes the Government Cloud Strategy (2023-2027) as aiming to modernise government service delivery through cloud adoption; the document gives no adoption date beyond the 2023-2027 period.
